Liberation War ministry secy made OSD
2014-05-08T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/liberation-war-ministry-secy-made-osd-23259

Additional Secretary to Ministry of Liberation War Affairs Golam Mostafa has been made an Officer on Special Duty (OSD). The public administration ministry issued a circular about this last evening but did not mention any reason for making him OSD. Recently, allegations have surfaced that substandard crests were awarded to Bangladesh's foreign friends, who contributed in the 1971 Liberation War. Sources said Mostafa was made OSD because he was head of the crest purchasing committee. According to reports, each crest contained  around 2.36 grams of gold in place of the specified 11.64 grams and had an alloy of base metals instead of 350 grams of silver.
